verses.sloka: प्रसक्ताश्रुमुखीत्येवं ब्रुवन्ती जनकात्मजा ।अधोमुखमुखी बाला विलप्तुमुपचक्रमे ।। ५.२४.१।।।।
verses.transliteration: prasaktāśrumukhītyevaṁ bruvantī janakātmajā ।adhomukhamukhī bālā vilaptumupacakrame ।। 5.24.1।।।।

translations.english: Then the hideous ogresses approached Sita and spoke these harsh words in an unbecoming manner:

verses.sloka: उन्मत्तेव प्रमत्तेव भ्रान्तचित्तेव शोचती ।उपावृत्ता किशोरीव विवेष्टन्ती महीतले ।। ५.२४.२।।।।
verses.transliteration: unmatteva pramatteva bhrāntacitteva śocatī ।upāvṛttā kiśorīva viveṣṭantī mahītale ।। 5.24.2।।।।

translations.english: 'O Sita why don't you agree to dwell in Ravana's inner apartment furnished with fine bedsteads, and which is delightful?
translations.hindi: उन राक्षसियों के इस प्रकार कहने पर पातिब्रतधर्म पालन में दृढ़तापूर्वक तत्पर सीता अत्यन्त त्रस्त हो, गदगद वाणी से बोली

verses.sloka: राघवस्याप्रमत्तस्य रक्षसा कामरूपिणा ।रावणेन प्रमथ्याहमानीता क्रोशती बलात् ।। ५.२४.३।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāghavasyāpramattasya rakṣasā kāmarūpiṇā ।rāvaṇena pramathyāhamānītā krośatī balāt ।। 5.24.3।।।।

translations.english: 'You are a woman, wife of Rama, an ordinary mortal you are holding in high esteem. Withdraw your mind from Rama or else you will not survive.
translations.hindi: भला कहीं मानुषी भी राक्षस की भार्या बन सकती है । तुम सव भले ही मुझे मार कर खा डालो, पर मैं तुम्हारी यह बात नहीं मान सकती

verses.sloka: राक्षसी वशमापन्ना भर्त्यमाना सुदारुणम् ।चिन्तयन्ती सुदुःखार्ता नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे ।। ५.२४.४।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasī vaśamāpannā bhartyamānā sudāruṇam ।cintayantī suduḥkhārtā nāhaṁ jīvitumutsahe ।। 5.24.4।।।।

translations.english: "Accept Ravana as your husband and after uniting with him enjoy all the pleasures of the three worlds.
translations.hindi: उस समय राक्षसियों के बीच फंसी हुई देवकन्यावत्‌ सीता को, दुःख से छुटकारा पाने का कुछ श्रौर उपाय नहीं सूझ पड़ता था । क्योंकि एक तो वह दुःख से विकल थीं ही, तिस पर रावण ने उन्हें घमकाया भी था

verses.sloka: न हि मे जीवितेनार्थो नैवार्थैर्न च भूषणैः ।वसन्त्या राक्षसी मध्ये विना रामं महारथम् ।। ५.२४.५।।।।
verses.transliteration: na hi me jīvitenārtho naivārthairna ca bhūṣaṇaiḥ ।vasantyā rākṣasī madhye vinā rāmaṁ mahāratham ।। 5.24.5।।।।

translations.english: 'O charming lady you have an irreproachable beauty and grace. Why do you think of human Rama only who has been dethroned from the kingdom. He is only a human being who is unsuccessful and distressful.'
translations.hindi: उस समय सीता थरथर काँप रही थी श्रौर मारे डर के सिकुड़ कर, झपने शरीर में घुसी जाती थी । मानों अपने झु ड से भ्रलग हुई कोई ग्रकेली हिरनी भेड्यों से घिरी हो

verses.sloka: धिङ्मामनार्यामसतीं याहं तेन विना कृता ।मुहूर्तमपि रक्षामि जीवितं पापजीविता ।। ५.२४.६।।।।
verses.transliteration: dhiṅmāmanāryāmasatīṁ yāhaṁ tena vinā kṛtā ।muhūrtamapi rakṣāmi jīvitaṁ pāpajīvitā ।। 5.24.6।।।।

translations.english: Hearing the words of the ogresses, Sita with eyes like lotus petals full of tears replied this way:
translations.hindi: शरीर के थरथराने से जानकी की बड़ी लम्बी श्रौर घनी चोटी भी थरथराने लगी । उस समय वह हिलती हुई चोटी ऐसी जान पड़ी मानो नागिन लहरा रही हो

verses.sloka: का च मे जीविते श्रद्धा सुखे वा तं प्रियं विना ।भर्तारं सागरान्ताया वसुधायाः प्रियं वदम् ।। ५.२४.७।।।।
verses.transliteration: kā ca me jīvite śraddhā sukhe vā taṁ priyaṁ vinā ।bhartāraṁ sāgarāntāyā vasudhāyāḥ priyaṁ vadam ।। 5.24.7।।।।

translations.english: "All of you joined together and spoke such words that are not acceptable to the world. Your sinful words of advice do not appeal to me.
translations.hindi: वह भ्रत्यन्त शोक से विकल तथा हताश हो, उस वृक्ष की पुष्पित डाली को थाम कर, भ्रपने पति श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का स्मरण करने लगी ॥॥६] सा स्नापयन्ती विपुलौस्तनो नेत्रजलस्रवैः। चिन्तयन्ती न शोकस्य तदाऽन्तमधिगच्छति

verses.sloka: भिद्यतां भक्ष्यतां वापि शरीरं विसृजाम्यहम् ।न चाप्यहं चिरं दुःखं सहेयं प्रियवर्जिता ।। ५.२४.८।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhidyatāṁ bhakṣyatāṁ vāpi śarīraṁ visṛjāmyaham ।na cāpyahaṁ ciraṁ duḥkhaṁ saheyaṁ priyavarjitā ।। 5.24.8।।।।

translations.english: ' A human being ought not to become wife of a demon. Devour me if you want. I refuse to accept your advice.'
translations.hindi: ग्रंत में वह थरथरा कर वायु के झोके से गिरे हुए केले के पेड़ की तरह जमीन पर गिर पड़ी श्रौर राक्षसियों के डर से उसका मुख, फीका पड़ गया व उदास हो गया

verses.sloka: चरणेनापि सव्येन न स्पृशेयं निशाचरम् ।रावणं किं पुनरहं कामयेयं विगर्हितम् ।। ५.२४.९।।।।
verses.transliteration: caraṇenāpi savyena na spṛśeyaṁ niśācaram ।rāvaṇaṁ kiṁ punarahaṁ kāmayeyaṁ vigarhitam ।। 5.24.9।।।।

translations.english: 'Dejected or dethroned from the kingdom, Rama is my lawful husband. I will ever remain devoted to Rama as Suvarchala, wife of the Sungod is to him.

verses.sloka: प्रत्याख्यातं न जानाति नात्मानं नात्मनः कुलम् ।यो नृशंस स्वभावेन मां प्रार्थयितुमिच्छति ।। ५.२४.१०।।।।
verses.transliteration: pratyākhyātaṁ na jānāti nātmānaṁ nātmanaḥ kulam ।yo nṛśaṁsa svabhāvena māṁ prārthayitumicchati ।। 5.24.10।।।।

translations.english: 'I am steadfast (in love) to my husband Rama, the foremost of the Ikshvaku family in the same manner as noble Sachi to Indra, Arundhati to Vasistha, Rohini to the Moon, Lopamudra to Agastya, Sukanya to sage Chyavana, Savitri to Satyavan, Srimati to Kapilamuni Madayanti to Soudasu, Kesini to king Sagara and Bhima's daughter Damayanti to her lord Nala, (the king of Nishadas)'.
translations.hindi: दुखिया जानकी शोक से श्रचत हो श्रौर श्रीराम के विरह से विकल हो, उसाँसें लेती हुई, विलाप करके रोने लगी

verses.sloka: छिन्ना भिन्ना विभक्ता वा दीप्ते वाग्नौ प्रदीपिता ।रावणं नोपतिष्ठेयं किं प्रलापेन वश् चिरम् ।। ५.२४.११।।।।
verses.transliteration: chinnā bhinnā vibhaktā vā dīpte vāgnau pradīpitā ।rāvaṇaṁ nopatiṣṭheyaṁ kiṁ pralāpena vaś ciram ।। 5.24.11।।।।

translations.english: 'I am steadfast (in love) to my husband Rama, the foremost of the Ikshvaku family in the same manner as noble Sachi to Indra, Arundhati to Vasistha, Rohini to the Moon, Lopamudra to Agastya, Sukanya to sage Chyavana, Savitri to Satyavan, Srimati to Kapilamuni Madayanti to Soudasu, Kesini to king Sagara and Bhima's daughter Damayanti to her lord Nala, (the king of Nishadas)'.
translations.hindi: जानकी विनाप करती हुई कहने लगी--हा राम ! हा लक्ष्मण [ हा भेरी सास कौसल्ये ! हा भामिनी सुमित्रे !

verses.sloka: ख्यातः प्राज्ञः कृतज्ञश्च सानुक्रोशश्च राघवः ।सद्वृत्तो निरनुक्रोशः शङ्के मद्भाग्यसङ्क्षयात् ।। ५.२४.१२।।।।
verses.transliteration: khyātaḥ prājñaḥ kṛtajñaśca sānukrośaśca rāghavaḥ ।sadvṛtto niranukrośaḥ śaṅke madbhāgyasaṅkṣayāt ।। 5.24.12।।।।

translations.english: 'I am steadfast (in love) to my husband Rama, the foremost of the Ikshvaku family in the same manner as noble Sachi to Indra, Arundhati to Vasistha, Rohini to the Moon, Lopamudra to Agastya, Sukanya to sage Chyavana, Savitri to Satyavan, Srimati to Kapilamuni Madayanti to Soudasu, Kesini to king Sagara and Bhima's daughter Damayanti to her lord Nala, (the king of Nishadas)'.
translations.hindi: संसार में पंडितों की कही हुई यह कहावत ठीक है कि बिना समय आए, स्त्री हो या पुइप, कोई नहीं मरता

verses.sloka: राक्षसानां जनस्थाने सहस्राणि चतुर्दश ।येनैकेन निरस्तानि स मां किं नाभिपद्यते ।। ५.२४.१३।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasānāṁ janasthāne sahasrāṇi caturdaśa ।yenaikena nirastāni sa māṁ kiṁ nābhipadyate ।। 5.24.13।।।।

translations.english: Hearing the reply of Sita, the ogresses ordered by Ravana and overtaken by anger again began to threaten Sita using harsh words.
translations.hindi: नहीं तो क्या, यह सम्भव था कि, जैसा कि ये दुष्ट राक्षसी मुझको सता रही हे; दुखिया में, श्रोरामचन्द्रजी बिना एक मुहूर्त भी जीती रहती

verses.sloka: निरुद्धा रावणेनाहमल्पवीर्येण रक्षसा ।समर्थः खलु मे भर्ता रावणं हन्तुमाहवे ।। ५.२४.१४।।।।
verses.transliteration: niruddhā rāvaṇenāhamalpavīryeṇa rakṣasā ।samarthaḥ khalu me bhartā rāvaṇaṁ hantumāhave ।। 5.24.14।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman who kept himself concealed on the simsupa tree speechlessly listened to the ogresses threatening Sita.
translations.hindi: म॑ म्रल्पपुण्या प्रौर.दुखियारी एक अताथिती को तरह वैसे ही नष्ट हो जाऊँगी; जैसे वोझ से लदी नाव समुद्र में वायु के झोकों से नष्ट हो जाती है

verses.sloka: विराधो दण्डकारण्ये येन राक्षसपुङ्गवः ।रणे रामेण निहतः स मां किं नाभिपद्यते ।। ५.२४.१५।।।।
verses.transliteration: virādho daṇḍakāraṇye yena rākṣasapuṅgavaḥ ।raṇe rāmeṇa nihataḥ sa māṁ kiṁ nābhipadyate ।। 5.24.15।।।।

translations.english: Sita was trembling in fear. The enraged ogresses went on licking their lips hanging, again and again.
translations.hindi: में प्रपने पति की अनुपस्थिति में इन राक्षसियों के पल्ले पड़ गई हूँ और उती प्रकार निश्चय ही नष्ट हो रही हूँ, जिस प्रकार पानी के घक्कोँ से नदी-तट नष्ट होता है

verses.sloka: कामं मध्ये समुद्रस्य लङ्केयं दुष्प्रधर्षणा ।न तु राघवबाणानां गतिरोधी ह विद्यते ।। ५.२४.१६।।।।
verses.transliteration: kāmaṁ madhye samudrasya laṅkeyaṁ duṣpradharṣaṇā ।na tu rāghavabāṇānāṁ gatirodhī ha vidyate ।। 5.24.16।।।।

translations.english: The enraged ogresses immediately picked up the axes and rose up saying, 'she is unfit to have the demon king, Ravana as her husband'.
translations.hindi: जो उन कमलनयन, सिंहविक्राल्तगामी, कृतज्ञ श्रौर मधुरभाषी मेरे स्वामी के दर्शन करते हूँ; वे धन्य हे

verses.sloka: किं नु तत्कारणं येन रामो दृढपराक्रमः ।रक्षसापहृतां भार्यामिष्टां नाभ्यवपद्यते ।। ५.२४.१७।।।।
verses.transliteration: kiṁ nu tatkāraṇaṁ yena rāmo dṛḍhaparākramaḥ ।rakṣasāpahṛtāṁ bhāryāmiṣṭāṁ nābhyavapadyate ।। 5.24.17।।।।

translations.english: As the charming Sita was threatened by the fierce ogresses, she moved towards the simsupa tree with eyes full of tears.
translations.hindi: उन प्रसिद्ध (अथवा ग्रात्मज्ञानी) श्रीरामचन्द्रजी के बिना मेरा जीना सर्वथा वेसे ही कठिन है; जैसे हलाहल विष को पी कर पीने वाले का जीना कठिन होता है

verses.sloka: इहस्थां मां न जानीते शङ्के लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः ।जानन्नपि हि तेजस्वी धर्षणां मर्षयिष्यति ।। ५.२४.१८।।।।
verses.transliteration: ihasthāṁ māṁ na jānīte śaṅke lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ ।jānannapi hi tejasvī dharṣaṇāṁ marṣayiṣyati ।। 5.24.18।।।।

translations.english: Then the largeeyed Sita, drowned in sorrow surrounded by the ogresses went near the simsupa tree and stood there.
translations.hindi: नहीं मालूम मेंने पिछले जन्मों में कैसे पापकर्म किए थे; "जिनके फल- स्वरूप मुझे यह घोर दारुण दुःख सहना पड़ रहा है

verses.sloka: हृतेति योऽधिगत्वा मां राघवाय निवेदयेत् ।गृध्रराजोऽपि स रणे रावणेन निपातितः ।। ५.२४.१९।।।।
verses.transliteration: hṛteti yo'dhigatvā māṁ rāghavāya nivedayet ।gṛdhrarājo'pi sa raṇe rāvaṇena nipātitaḥ ।। 5.24.19।।।।

translations.english: The ogresses started intimidating Sita who was dressed in soiled clothes and emaciated with a dejected look on her face.

verses.sloka: कृतं कर्म महत्तेन मां तदाभ्यवपद्यता ।तिष्ठता रावणद्वन्द्वे वृद्धेनापि जटायुषा ।। ५.२४.२०।।।।
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṁ karma mahattena māṁ tadābhyavapadyatā ।tiṣṭhatā rāvaṇadvandve vṛddhenāpi jaṭāyuṣā ।। 5.24.20।।।।

translations.english: Then a dark ogress called Vinata with a terryfying look, loathsome appearance and a large sunken belly said to Sita:

verses.sloka: यदि मामिह जानीयाद्वर्तमानां स राघवः ।अद्य बाणैरभिक्रुद्धः कुर्याल्लोकमराक्षसं ।। ५.२४.२१।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadi māmiha jānīyādvartamānāṁ sa rāghavaḥ ।adya bāṇairabhikruddhaḥ kuryāllokamarākṣasaṁ ।। 5.24.21।।।।

translations.english: 'O Sita you have shown your love for your husband to this extent. It is enough. O auspicious lady anything carried to excess leads to adversity.

verses.sloka: विधमेच्च पुरीं लङ्कां शोषयेच्च महोदधिम् ।रावणस्य च नीचस्य कीर्तिं नाम च नाशयेत् ।।५.२४.२२।।।।
verses.transliteration: vidhamecca purīṁ laṅkāṁ śoṣayecca mahodadhim ।rāvaṇasya ca nīcasya kīrtiṁ nāma ca nāśayet ।।5.24.22।।।।

translations.english: "O Mythili I beseech you (to oblige Ravana). You have discharged your duty as a human being. Be happy. But you should also heed my advice which is, after all, salutary.

verses.sloka: ततो निहतनथानां राक्षसीनां गृहे गृहे ।यथाहमेवं रुदती तथा भूयो न संशयः ।अन्विष्य रक्षसां लङ्कां कुर्याद्रामः सलक्ष्मणः ।। ५.२४.२३।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato nihatanathānāṁ rākṣasīnāṁ gṛhe gṛhe ।yathāhamevaṁ rudatī tathā bhūyo na saṁśayaḥ ।anviṣya rakṣasāṁ laṅkāṁ kuryādrāmaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ ।। 5.24.23।।।।

translations.english: 'Accept as your husband the demon king Ravana, courageous and handsome like Indra, king of the gods generous, sacrificing and pleasing.

verses.sloka: न हि ताभ्यां रिपुर्दृष्टो मुहूतमपि जीवति ।चिता धूमाकुलपथा गृध्रमण्डलसङ्कुला ।अचिरेण तु लङ्केयं श्मशानसदृशी भवेत् ।। ५.२४.२४।।।।
verses.transliteration: na hi tābhyāṁ ripurdṛṣṭo muhūtamapi jīvati ।citā dhūmākulapathā gṛdhramaṇḍalasaṅkulā ।acireṇa tu laṅkeyaṁ śmaśānasadṛśī bhavet ।। 5.24.24।।।।

translations.english: 'Accept as your husband the demon king Ravana, courageous and handsome like Indra, king of the gods generous, sacrificing and pleasing.

verses.sloka: अचिरेणैव कालेन प्राप्स्याम्येव मनोरथम् ।दुष्प्रस्थानोऽयमाख्याति सर्वेषां वो विपर्ययः ।। ५.२४.२५।।।।
verses.transliteration: acireṇaiva kālena prāpsyāmyeva manoratham ।duṣprasthāno'yamākhyāti sarveṣāṁ vo viparyayaḥ ।। 5.24.25।।।।

translations.english: 'Leave the helpless human Rama and seek Ravana's refuge. O Vaidehi, using the heavenly unguents and adorned with imposing ornaments from now on, be the queen of all people.

verses.sloka: यादृशानि तु दृश्यन्ते लङ्कायामशुभानि तु ।अचिरेणैव कालेन भविष्यति हतप्रभा ।। ५.२४.२६।।।।
verses.transliteration: yādṛśāni tu dṛśyante laṅkāyāmaśubhāni tu ।acireṇaiva kālena bhaviṣyati hataprabhā ।। 5.24.26।।।।

translations.english: O beautiful Sita Just like Swaha, queen to the Firegod and Sachi to Indra, accept Ravana. Why are you still thinking of Rama who is helpless and whose life span is coming to an end soon.

verses.sloka: नूनं लङ्का हते पापे रावणे राक्षसाधिपे ।शोषं यास्यति दुर्धर्षा प्रमदा विधवा यथा ।। ५.२४.२७।।।।
verses.transliteration: nūnaṁ laṅkā hate pāpe rāvaṇe rākṣasādhipe ।śoṣaṁ yāsyati durdharṣā pramadā vidhavā yathā ।। 5.24.27।।।।

translations.english: 'If you do not heed our words of advice, all of us will eat you at this very moment.'

verses.sloka: पुष्योत्सवसमृद्धा च नष्टभर्त्री सराक्षसा ।भविष्यति पुरी लङ्का नष्टभर्त्री यथाङ्गना ।। ५.२४.२८।।।।
verses.transliteration: puṣyotsavasamṛddhā ca naṣṭabhartrī sarākṣasā ।bhaviṣyati purī laṅkā naṣṭabhartrī yathāṅganā ।। 5.24.28।।।।

translations.english: Now Vikata another ogress with hanging breasts raised her fist up in anger and roared at Sita.

verses.sloka: नूनं राक्षसकन्यानां रुदन्तीनां गृहे गृहे ।श्रोष्यामि नचिरादेव दुःखार्तानाम् इह ध्वनिम् ।। ५.२४.२९।।।।
verses.transliteration: nūnaṁ rākṣasakanyānāṁ rudantīnāṁ gṛhe gṛhe ।śroṣyāmi nacirādeva duḥkhārtānām iha dhvanim ।। 5.24.29।।।।

translations.english: O wicked Mythili! we have tolerated many unpleasant words uttered by you due to our kindness and mildness..

verses.sloka: सान्धकारा हतद्योता हतराक्षसपुङ्गवा ।भविष्यति पुरी लङ्का निर्दग्धा रामसायकैः ।। ५.२४.३०।।।।
verses.transliteration: sāndhakārā hatadyotā hatarākṣasapuṅgavā ।bhaviṣyati purī laṅkā nirdagdhā rāmasāyakaiḥ ।। 5.24.30।।।।

translations.english: 'O Mythili you have heeded not our good and timely advice tendered in your interest. You have been brought to the other shore of the ocean and to the inner chambers of Ravana which is very difficult for others to access.

verses.sloka: यदि नाम स शूरो मां रामो रक्तान्तलोचनः ।जानीयाद्वर्तमानां हि रावणस्य निवेशने ।। ५.२४.३१।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadi nāma sa śūro māṁ rāmo raktāntalocanaḥ ।jānīyādvartamānāṁ hi rāvaṇasya niveśane ।। 5.24.31।।।।

translations.english: 'O Mythili you have heeded not our good and timely advice tendered in your interest. You have been brought to the other shore of the ocean and to the inner chambers of Ravana which is very difficult for others to access.

verses.sloka: अनेन तु नृशंसेन रावणेनाधमेन मे ।समयो यस्तु निर्दिष्टस्तस्य कालोऽयमागतः ।। ५.२४.३२।।।।
verses.transliteration: anena tu nṛśaṁsena rāvaṇenādhamena me ।samayo yastu nirdiṣṭastasya kālo'yamāgataḥ ।। 5.24.32।।।।

translations.english: 'You are in Ravana's house, wellguarded by us. It is not possible even for Indra, destroyer of citadels, to come to your rescue (let alone Rama).

verses.sloka: अकार्यं ये न जानन्ति नैरृताः पापकारिणः ।अधर्मात्तु महोत्पातो भविष्यति हि साम्प्रतम् ।। ५.२४.३३।।।।
verses.transliteration: akāryaṁ ye na jānanti nairṛtāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ ।adharmāttu mahotpāto bhaviṣyati hi sāmpratam ।। 5.24.33।।।।

translations.english: 'Mythili, act according to our advice. I am your wellwisher. Give up sorrow and stop shedding useless tears.

verses.sloka: नैते धर्मं विजानन्ति राक्षसाः पिशिताशनाः ।ध्रुवं मां प्रातराशार्थे राक्षसः कल्पयिष्यति ।। ५.२४.३४।।।।
verses.transliteration: naite dharmaṁ vijānanti rākṣasāḥ piśitāśanāḥ ।dhruvaṁ māṁ prātarāśārthe rākṣasaḥ kalpayiṣyati ।। 5.24.34।।।।

translations.english: 'O Sita offer your love to Ravana, adore him and be happy. Give up this continuous dejection. Enjoy all pleasures along with the king of demons.

verses.sloka: साहं कथं करिष्यामि तं विना प्रियदर्शनम् ।रामं रक्तान्तनयनमपश्यन्ती सुदुःखिता ।। ५.२४.३५।।।।
verses.transliteration: sāhaṁ kathaṁ kariṣyāmi taṁ vinā priyadarśanam ।rāmaṁ raktāntanayanamapaśyantī suduḥkhitā ।। 5.24.35।।।।

translations.english: 'O timid Sita know that youth of women is fleeting and transient. Before it is over, enjoy all kinds of pleasures.

verses.sloka: यदि कश्चित्प्रदाता मे विषस्याद्य भवेदिह ।क्षिप्रं वैवस्वतं देवं पश्येयं पतिना विना ।। ५.२४.३६।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadi kaścitpradātā me viṣasyādya bhavediha ।kṣipraṁ vaivasvataṁ devaṁ paśyeyaṁ patinā vinā ।। 5.24.36।।।।

translations.english: 'O lady of intoxicating eyes range in the company of the demon king, the delightful gardens and mountain ranges filled with gardens.

verses.sloka: नाजानाज्जीवतीं रामः स मां लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः ।जानन्तौ तौ न कुर्यातां नोर्व्यां हि मम मार्गणम् ।। ५.२४.३७।।।।
verses.transliteration: nājānājjīvatīṁ rāmaḥ sa māṁ lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ ।jānantau tau na kuryātāṁ norvyāṁ hi mama mārgaṇam ।। 5.24.37।।।।

translations.english: 'O beautiful Sita seven thousand ogresses will be at your beck and call. (Therefore) accept Ravana, the lord of all ogres as your husband.

verses.sloka: नूनं ममैव शोकेन स वीरो लक्ष्मणाग्रजः ।देवलोकमितो यातस्त्यक्त्वा देहं महीतले ।। ५.२४.३८।।।।
verses.transliteration: nūnaṁ mamaiva śokena sa vīro lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ ।devalokamito yātastyaktvā dehaṁ mahītale ।। 5.24.38।।।।

translations.english: 'O Mythili if you heed not my words of advice, I will pluck out your heart and eat it up'.

verses.sloka: धन्या देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः ।मम पश्यन्ति ये नाथं रामं राजीवलोचनम् ।। ५.२४.३९।।।।
verses.transliteration: dhanyā devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ ।mama paśyanti ye nāthaṁ rāmaṁ rājīvalocanam ।। 5.24.39।।।।

translations.english: Next spoke a fiercelooking ogress called Chandodari, overcome with anger taking up a huge trident and rotating.

verses.sloka: अथ वा न हि तस्यार्थे धर्मकामस्य धीमतः ।मया रामस्य राजर्षेर्भार्यया परमात्मनः ।। ५.२४.४०।।।।
verses.transliteration: atha vā na hi tasyārthe dharmakāmasya dhīmataḥ ।mayā rāmasya rājarṣerbhāryayā paramātmanaḥ ।। 5.24.40।।।।

translations.english: 'I have developed a morbid desire to feast upon this woman with eyes flashing like doe's, whose breasts heave with stress and fear after she was abducted by Ravana.

verses.sloka: दृश्यमाने भवेत्प्रीतः सौहृदं नास्त्यपश्यतः ।नाशयन्ति कृतघ्रास्तु न रामो नाशयिष्यति ।। ५.२४.४१।।।।
verses.transliteration: dṛśyamāne bhavetprītaḥ sauhṛdaṁ nāstyapaśyataḥ ।nāśayanti kṛtaghrāstu na rāmo nāśayiṣyati ।। 5.24.41।।।।

translations.english: 'I thought of feasting on your spleen, liver, heart, all the joints, head and intestines.'

verses.sloka: किं नु मे न गुणाः के चित्किं वा भाग्य क्षयो हि मे ।याहं सीता वरार्हेण हीना रामेण भामिनी ।। ५.२४.४२।।।।
verses.transliteration: kiṁ nu me na guṇāḥ ke citkiṁ vā bhāgya kṣayo hi me ।yāhaṁ sītā varārheṇa hīnā rāmeṇa bhāminī ।। 5.24.42।।।।

translations.english: Next spoke an ogress called Praghasa, saying 'Why not we twist and squeeze the neck of this heartless lady. Why are you sitting idle still? Come on.'

verses.sloka: श्रेयो मे जीवितान्मर्तुं विहीना या महात्मना ।रामादक्लिष्टचारित्राच्छूराच्छत्रुनिबर्हणात् ।। ५.२४.४३।।।।
verses.transliteration: śreyo me jīvitānmartuṁ vihīnā yā mahātmanā ।rāmādakliṣṭacāritrācchūrācchatrunibarhaṇāt ।। 5.24.43।।।।

translations.english: 'Thereafter we will announce that such a human being is dead. Then Ravana will simply say 'eat her up'. There is no doubt .'

verses.sloka: अथ वा न्यस्तशस्त्रौ तौ वने मूलफलाशनौ ।भ्रातरौ हि नर श्रेष्ठौ चरन्तौ वनगोचरौ ।। ५.२४.४४।।।।
verses.transliteration: atha vā nyastaśastrau tau vane mūlaphalāśanau ।bhrātarau hi nara śreṣṭhau carantau vanagocarau ।। 5.24.44।।।।

translations.english: Then an ogress called Ajamukhi said, 'Let her body be cut into lumps of equal pieces.

verses.sloka: अथ वा राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन दुरात्मना ।छद्मना घातितौ शूरौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ५.२४.४५।।।।
verses.transliteration: atha vā rākṣasendreṇa rāvaṇena durātmanā ।chadmanā ghātitau śūrau bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 5.24.45।।।।

translations.english: 'We shall share them. I do not like disputes in this regard. Go swiftly and get drinks and food to lick. Let the accompanying dishes of all variety and quality be brought.'

verses.sloka: साहमेवङ्गते काले मर्तुमिच्छामि सर्वथा ।न च मे विहितो मृत्युरस्मिन्दुःखेऽपि वर्तति ।। ५.२४.४६।।।।
verses.transliteration: sāhamevaṅgate kāle martumicchāmi sarvathā ।na ca me vihito mṛtyurasminduḥkhe'pi vartati ।। 5.24.46।।।।

translations.english: Then an ogress called Surpanakha said, 'I too like the proposal of Ajamukhi.'

verses.sloka: धन्याः खलु महात्मानो मुनयः सत्यसंमताः ।जितात्मानो महाभागा येषां न स्तः प्रियाप्रिये ।। ५.२४.४७।।।।
verses.transliteration: dhanyāḥ khalu mahātmāno munayaḥ satyasaṁmatāḥ ।jitātmāno mahābhāgā yeṣāṁ na staḥ priyāpriye ।। 5.24.47।।।।

translations.english: 'Get the wine quickly, destroyer of all sorrows. After relishing the human flesh we will start Nikumbhila dance.'

verses.sloka: प्रियान्न सम्भवेद्दुःखमप्रियादधिकं भयम् ।ताभ्यां हि ये वियुज्यन्ते नमस्तेषां महात्मनाम् ।। ५.२४.४८।।।।
verses.transliteration: priyānna sambhavedduḥkhamapriyādadhikaṁ bhayam ।tābhyāṁ hi ye viyujyante namasteṣāṁ mahātmanām ।। 5.24.48।।।।

translations.english: Threatened by the ogresses in that manner, Sita who was like the daughter of a god, cried aloud. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे चतुर्विंशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the twentyfourth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

verses.sloka: साहं त्यक्ता प्रियेणेह रामेण विदितात्मना ।प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्यामि पापस्य रावणस्य गता वशम् ।। ५.२४.४९।।
verses.transliteration: sāhaṁ tyaktā priyeṇeha rāmeṇa viditātmanā ।prāṇāṁstyakṣyāmi pāpasya rāvaṇasya gatā vaśam ।। 5.24.49।।
